session.title: Maragang Hill controlled family hike
session.purpose: Enjoy the confirmed Kundasang family hike while using the 1900-2350 m ascent as controlled aerobic, uphill torque and hiking-durability exposure without manufacturing fatigue that delays the post-travel Enduro reacquisition block.

dose.effort: RPE 3-4 for most of the ascent; brief RPE 5 is acceptable on steep steps, with no intensity target.
dose.day_rule: This hike is today's only substantive exposure. Do not add a run, gym session or bike workout.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A conversational 450 m ascent provides useful low-consequence aerobic and uphill muscular endurance, while a controlled descent adds modest eccentric durability. Keeping intensity and descent impact controlled should allow this travel exposure to be absorbed before the August 10 Enduro reacquisition block.
execution_rules: Complete an altitude symptom gate before leaving: no new headache with nausea or dizziness, no unusual fatigue, no breathlessness at rest, no chest tightness or persistent cough, and normal balance and coordination.
Use the talk test and RPE rather than normal sea-level heart-rate expectations; altitude can raise ventilation and heart rate at a given pace.
Walk the first 15 minutes deliberately easy, then hold a sustainable family pace. Do not chase elevation speed, steps, intensity minutes or Garmin load.
On wet steps or roots, shorten stride, keep the centre of mass over the feet and control the descent; do not bound or run downhill.

The 90-minute duration is the stated itinerary, not permission to under-carry. Carry enough fluid, carbohydrate and weather protection for a longer return if 90 minutes describes only the outward leg.
Aim to be off exposed terrain before the forecast afternoon thunderstorm window.

expected_result.during: Conversational breathing, stable coordination and RPE 3-4 without progressive altitude symptoms.
expected_result.after: Pleasant leg work with no marked quadriceps damage, headache, nausea, dizziness or disproportionate exhaustion.
expected_result.next_day: Normal walking, cognition and recovery; the hike is absorbed as travel-life load rather than a hidden hard session.

stop_rules: Do not ascend if headache is accompanied by nausea, dizziness or unusual fatigue, or if there is breathlessness at rest, chest tightness, persistent cough, confusion or abnormal coordination.
Stop ascending and descend if altitude symptoms appear or worsen despite rest; confusion, ataxia, breathlessness at rest or chest symptoms require prompt descent and medical assessment.
Lightning, thunder, rapidly building cloud, unsafe wet footing or guide concern overrides the route and turnaround plan.
Musculoskeletal pain that changes gait ends the training interpretation; use the safest family return.

nutrition.pre_hike: Espresso is fine if customary, but pair it with breakfast containing approximately 40-60 g carbohydrate and some protein, plus 300-500 ml fluid before rollout.
nutrition.carry_for_90_min: Carry at least 750-1000 ml fluid and 30-45 g carbohydrate; include roughly 300-600 mg sodium per litre if sweating meaningfully.
nutrition.longer_route_rule: If 90 minutes is the ascent rather than total duration, plan 30-45 g carbohydrate and approximately 400-700 ml fluid per hour, with enough carried or refill access for the full return.
